edge.title: Add Contra-Muon: subtract 0.2× spectrally normalized momentum after NS
edge.summary: Keeps #9's NorMuon-lite + u/w-floor Muon and inserts Contra-Muon inside muon_update: a copy of the Nesterov momentum M is scaled to unit spectral norm (5-step power iteration), and after Newton–Schulz 0.2·M/σ̂max (CONTRA_MUON/2) is subtracted and the result is rescaled to the NS output's Frobenius norm. With M = UΣVᵀ and NS(M) ≈ UVᵀ this maps singular values to ≈ 1 − 0.2·σ/σmax instead of 1, damping the dominant momentum directions relative to weak ones (an anti-gradient tilt meant to diversify the update). Everything downstream (aspect scale, NorMuon-lite, u/w floor 0.35, lr 0.0375, effective wd 0) is unchanged; the run is shortened from 3250 to 3225 steps.

changes.label: Contra-Muon term around NS
changes.detail: muon_update computes normalized_grad = scale_to_unit_operator_norm(M) before NS, then update = NS(M) − CONTRA_MUON/2 · normalized_grad with CONTRA_MUON = 0.4, rescaled to ‖NS(M)‖_F before the aspect-ratio scale, NorMuon-lite and the u/w floor.

changes.label: train_steps 3250 → 3225
changes.detail: The linear cooldown (cooldown_frac 0.7) now ends at 3225, which is also the claimed step; extra validation at 3150/3175/3200/3225.

changes.label: Constants hoisted, seeding, logging
changes.detail: MU, MUON_LR, MUON_WEIGHT_DECAY and TARGET_UW become module constants with unchanged values; torch.manual_seed(SEED) from env (default 0); cuDNN SDPA backend disabled; config prints; no step-0 validation.

edge.parent_check: consistent — nearest-code is #9; the diff vs #9 is exactly the Contra-Muon insertion plus constant hoisting, seeding and logging.
edge.noise: Docstring, module-level constants with unchanged values, env SEED + torch.manual_seed, cuDNN SDPA disabled (backend/numerics only), config prints, validation-loop refactor (skips step 0, extra late checkpoints).

mechanisms.name: Contra-Muon
mechanisms.explain: Before Newton–Schulz, a copy of the Nesterov momentum M is divided by its spectral norm, estimated with 5 power iterations from an all-ones vector. After NS, CONTRA_MUON/2 = 0.2 times this normalized momentum is subtracted and the result is rescaled to the Frobenius norm of the NS output, so the singular-value map becomes ≈ 1 − 0.2·σ/σmax: dominant directions get slightly smaller steps than weak ones. The result then passes through the aspect scale, NorMuon-lite and the u/w floor as before.

caveats: MUON_WEIGHT_DECAY=0.025 is printed and stored but Muon.step never applies it (the README acknowledges effective wd 0; same as #9). The 'normalized gradient' is the Nesterov-blended momentum (the NS input), not the raw gradient, and σ̂max is a 5-iteration power-method estimate. The table reports p=0.69 vs #9, so the 25-step gain over #9 itself is not statistically established.
